14 # Extended non-negative reals
15 
16 We define `ENNReal = ℝ≥0∞ := WithTop ℝ≥0` to be the type of extended nonnegative real numbers,
17 i.e., the interval `[0, +∞]`. This type is used as the codomain of a `MeasureTheory.Measure`,
18 and of the extended distance `edist` in an `EMetricSpace`.
19 
20 In this file we set up many of the instances on `ℝ≥0∞`, and provide relationships between `ℝ≥0∞` and
21 `ℝ≥0`, and between `ℝ≥0∞` and `ℝ`. In particular, we provide a coercion from `ℝ≥0` to `ℝ≥0∞` as well
22 as functions `ENNReal.toNNReal`, `ENNReal.ofReal` and `ENNReal.toReal`, all of which take the value
23 zero wherever they cannot be the identity. Also included is the relationship between `ℝ≥0∞` and `ℕ`.
24 The interaction of these functions, especially `ENNReal.ofReal` and `ENNReal.toReal`, with the
25 algebraic and lattice structure can be found in `Data.ENNReal.Real`.
26 
27 This file proves many of the order properties of `ℝ≥0∞`, with the exception of the ways those relate
28 to the algebraic structure, which are included in `Data.ENNReal.Operations`.
29 This file also defines inversion and division: this includes `Inv` and `Div` instances on `ℝ≥0∞`
30 making it into a `DivInvOneMonoid`.
31 As a consequence of being a `DivInvOneMonoid`, `ℝ≥0∞` inherits a power operation with integer
32 exponent: this and other properties is shown in `Data.ENNReal.Inv`.
33 
34 
35 ## Main definitions
36 
37 * `ℝ≥0∞`: the extended nonnegative real numbers `[0, ∞]`; defined as `WithTop ℝ≥0`; it is
38   equipped with the following structures:
39 
40   - coercion from `ℝ≥0` defined in the natural way;
41 
42   - the natural structure of a complete dense linear order: `↑p ≤ ↑q ↔ p ≤ q` and `∀ a, a ≤ ∞`;
43 
44   - `a + b` is defined so that `↑p + ↑q = ↑(p + q)` for `(p q : ℝ≥0)` and `a + ∞ = ∞ + a = ∞`;
45 
46   - `a * b` is defined so that `↑p * ↑q = ↑(p * q)` for `(p q : ℝ≥0)`, `0 * ∞ = ∞ * 0 = 0`, and
47     `a * ∞ = ∞ * a = ∞` for `a ≠ 0`;
48 
49   - `a - b` is defined as the minimal `d` such that `a ≤ d + b`; this way we have
50     `↑p - ↑q = ↑(p - q)`, `∞ - ↑p = ∞`, `↑p - ∞ = ∞ - ∞ = 0`; note that there is no negation, only
51     subtraction;
52 
53   The addition and multiplication defined this way together with `0 = ↑0` and `1 = ↑1` turn
54   `ℝ≥0∞` into a canonically ordered commutative semiring of characteristic zero.
55 
56   - `a⁻¹` is defined as `Inf {b | 1 ≤ a * b}`. This way we have `(↑p)⁻¹ = ↑(p⁻¹)` for
57     `p : ℝ≥0`, `p ≠ 0`, `0⁻¹ = ∞`, and `∞⁻¹ = 0`.
58   - `a / b` is defined as `a * b⁻¹`.
59 
60   This inversion and division include `Inv` and `Div` instances on `ℝ≥0∞`,
61   making it into a `DivInvOneMonoid`. Further properties of these are shown in `Data.ENNReal.Inv`.
62 
63 * Coercions to/from other types:
64 
65   - coercion `ℝ≥0 → ℝ≥0∞` is defined as `Coe`, so one can use `(p : ℝ≥0)` in a context that
66     expects `a : ℝ≥0∞`, and Lean will apply `coe` automatically;
67 
68   - `ENNReal.toNNReal` sends `↑p` to `p` and `∞` to `0`;
69 
70   - `ENNReal.toReal := coe ∘ ENNReal.toNNReal` sends `↑p`, `p : ℝ≥0` to `(↑p : ℝ)` and `∞` to `0`;
71 
72   - `ENNReal.ofReal := coe ∘ Real.toNNReal` sends `x : ℝ` to `↑⟨max x 0, _⟩`
73 
74   - `ENNReal.neTopEquivNNReal` is an equivalence between `{a : ℝ≥0∞ // a ≠ 0}` and `ℝ≥0`.
75 
76 ## Implementation notes
77 
78 We define a `CanLift ℝ≥0∞ ℝ≥0` instance, so one of the ways to prove theorems about an `ℝ≥0∞`
79 number `a` is to consider the cases `a = ∞` and `a ≠ ∞`, and use the tactic `lift a to ℝ≥0 using ha`
80 in the second case. This instance is even more useful if one already has `ha : a ≠ ∞` in the
81 context, or if we have `(f : α → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : ∀ x, f x ≠ ∞)`.
82 
83 ## Notation
84 
85 * `ℝ≥0∞`: the type of the extended nonnegative real numbers;
86 * `ℝ≥0`: the type of nonnegative real numbers `[0, ∞)`; defined in `Data.Real.NNReal`;
87 * `∞`: a localized notation in `ENNReal` for `⊤ : ℝ≥0∞`.
88 
89 -/

99 /-- The extended nonnegative real numbers. This is usually denoted [0, ∞],
100   and is relevant as the codomain of a measure. -/
101 def ENNReal := WithTop ℝ≥0
102   deriving Zero, Top, AddCommMonoidWithOne, SemilatticeSup, DistribLattice, Nontrivial
103

108 -- as `∞` rather than `top`. Despite this, we still use `top` in the names of lemmas.
109 /-- Notation for infinity as an `ENNReal` number. -/
110 scoped[ENNReal] notation3 "∞" => (⊤ : ENNReal)

437   toFun x := ENNReal.toNNReal x

439   left_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext <| coe_toNNReal x.2
440   right_inv := toNNReal_coe

566 theorem lt_iff_exists_rat_btwn :
567     a < b ↔ ∃ q : ℚ, 0 ≤ q ∧ a < Real.toNNReal q ∧ (Real.toNNReal q : ℝ≥0∞) < b :=
568   ⟨fun h => by
569     rcases lt_iff_exists_coe.1 h with ⟨p, rfl, _⟩
570     rcases exists_between h with ⟨c, pc, cb⟩
571     rcases lt_iff_exists_coe.1 cb with ⟨r, rfl, _⟩
572     rcases (NNReal.lt_iff_exists_rat_btwn _ _).1 (coe_lt_coe.1 pc) with ⟨q, hq0, pq, qr⟩
573     exact ⟨q, hq0, coe_lt_coe.2 pq, lt_trans (coe_lt_coe.2 qr) cb⟩,
574       fun ⟨_, _, qa, qb⟩ => lt_trans qa qb⟩
575 
576 theorem lt_iff_exists_real_btwn :
577     a < b ↔ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r ∧ a < ENNReal.ofReal r ∧ (ENNReal.ofReal r : ℝ≥0∞) < b :=
578   ⟨fun h =>
579     let ⟨q, q0, aq, qb⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_rat_btwn.1 h
580     ⟨q, Rat.cast_nonneg.2 q0, aq, qb⟩,
581     fun ⟨_, _, qa, qb⟩ => lt_trans qa qb⟩
582 
583 theorem lt_iff_exists_nnreal_btwn : a < b ↔ ∃ r : ℝ≥0, a < r ∧ (r : ℝ≥0∞) < b :=
584   WithTop.lt_iff_exists_coe_btwn

586 theorem lt_iff_exists_add_pos_lt : a < b ↔ ∃ r : ℝ≥0, 0 < r ∧ a + r < b := by
587   refine ⟨fun hab => ?_, fun ⟨r, _, hr⟩ => lt_of_le_of_lt le_self_add hr⟩
588   rcases lt_iff_exists_nnreal_btwn.1 hab with ⟨c, ac, cb⟩
589   lift a to ℝ≥0 using ac.ne_top
590   rw [coe_lt_coe] at ac
591   refine ⟨c - a, tsub_pos_iff_lt.2 ac, ?_⟩
592   rwa [← coe_add, add_tsub_cancel_of_le ac.le]

594 theorem le_of_forall_pos_le_add (h : ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, 0 < ε → b < ∞ → a ≤ b + ε) : a ≤ b := by

731 /-- Extension for the `positivity` tactic: `ENNReal.toReal`. -/
732 @[positivity ENNReal.toReal _]
733 meta def evalENNRealtoReal : PositivityExt where eval {u α} _zα _pα e := do
734   match u, α, e with
735   | 0, ~q(ℝ), ~q(ENNReal.toReal $a) =>
736     assertInstancesCommute
737     pure (.nonnegative q(ENNReal.toReal_nonneg))
738   | _, _, _ => throwError "not ENNReal.toReal"
739 
740 /-- Extension for the `positivity` tactic: `ENNReal.ofNNReal`. -/
741 @[positivity ENNReal.ofNNReal _]
742 meta def evalENNRealOfNNReal : PositivityExt where eval {u α} _zα _pα e := do
743   match u, α, e with
744   | 0, ~q(ℝ≥0∞), ~q(ENNReal.ofNNReal $a) =>
745     let ra ← core q(inferInstance) q(inferInstance) a
746     assertInstancesCommute
747     match ra with
748     | .positive pa => pure <| .positive q(ENNReal.coe_pos.mpr $pa)
749     | _ => pure .none
750   | _, _, _ => throwError "not ENNReal.ofNNReal"
751 
752 end Mathlib.Meta.Positivity
